description: Noctran's shared Renovate defaults: conventional commits, merge commits, a 3-day soak, minor/patch of 1.x+ automerged once checks are green, every major behind Dependency Dashboard approval. Extend with github>Noctran/.github:renovate-config; repositories with container images also extend github>Noctran/.github:soak.

packageRules.description: Minor/patch updates of 1.x+ dependencies automerge once checks are green; 0.x makes no compatibility promise, so it waits for a human
Every major waits for Dependency Dashboard approval and is never automerged (Homelab #729)
